metadata.title: निर्दोष कुकी को मरने के लिए किसने छोड़ा? | Why innocent Kukis were left behind in valley?
metadata.description:
Manipur has experienced unprecedented violence over the past two and a half months, with significant consequences for the poorest segments of society. Unfortunately, the plight of these marginalized individuals has received limited attention. The violence has adversely affected both the Kuki and Meitei communities, resulting in the loss of their livelihoods, homes, and hopes for a better future.

The situation in Manipur calls for urgent attention and concerted efforts to bring about peace and stability. It is crucial to address the root causes of the violence and work towards a comprehensive resolution that considers the needs and aspirations of all affected communities, particularly the poor.

Efforts should focus on promoting dialogue, understanding, and reconciliation among the different groups involved. Providing support and assistance to those who have lost their homes and sources of income is of utmost importance to help them rebuild their lives.

It is also vital for the wider society, media, and stakeholders to acknowledge the impact of violence on the most vulnerable members of the community. By raising awareness and advocating for their rights and well-being, we can ensure that their voices are heard and their needs are met in the process of finding a lasting solution to the conflict in Manipur.
